entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: [lName]-senpai.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: What a pleasant surprise. Are you[n]headed home too?
entries.uk: Яка приємна несподіванка.[n]Ви теж ідете додому?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Same here—I don't have club practice[n]today.
entries.uk: Я теж — сьогодні в мене[n]немає тренування в секції.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: That reminds me, there's something[n]I wanted to report to you. Would now[n]be a good time?
entries.uk: До речі, я хотіла вам дещо[n]повідомити. Зараз зручно?

entries.en: Sure thing.
I've got time.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thank you. Why don't we find a seat[n]somewhere?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Huh? [lName]-kun?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: And you are...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's been quite a while, Akechi-san.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: And the same for you...[n]Yoshizawa-san, right?
You know each other?
You two have a history?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: My father works at a TV station.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Have you ever seen "Good Morning[n]Japan"? My father's the director.
entries.uk: Ви бачили «Доброго ранку, Японіє»?[n]Мій тато — режисер цієї програми.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I've been brought onto the show[n]as a guest a number of times now.
entries.uk: Мене вже кілька разів запрошували[n]туди як гостя.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That's how I ended up becoming[n]acquainted with Yoshizawa-san.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I didn't know you knew her as well,[n][lName]-kun.
entries.uk: Не знав, що ти теж із нею знайомий,[n][lName]-кун.

entries.en: She and I made a deal.
She's my friend.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: *giggle* That's right. He's been offering[n]me guidance lately.
entries.uk: *хихоче* Саме так. Останнім часом[n]він дає мені настанови.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: A deal, you say? Huh, that's quite the[n]interesting relationship you two have.
entries.uk: Угоду, кажеш? Гм, доволі цікаві[n]у вас стосунки.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: He helped me out of a jam before,[n]and now he's been offering me[n]guidance.
entries.uk: Колись він виручив мене з халепи,[n]а тепер дає мені настанови.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Helped you out of a jam, eh? I see...
entries.uk: Виручив із халепи, значить? Он як...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So, what were you two up to?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, right! I was just about to share[n]some exciting news.
entries.uk: О, точно! Я саме збиралася[n]поділитися радісною новиною.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's nothing to keep secret, so I may[n]as well spill it now.
entries.uk: Це не таємниця, тож можу[n]розповісти просто зараз.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: About that summer competition[n]I mentioned to you before?
entries.uk: Пам'ятаєте літні змагання,[n]про які я вам казала?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I was chosen to be our club[n]representative!
Congratulations.
You did it.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: This only feels like the beginning to me,[n]though.
entries.uk: Але для мене це лише початок.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Isn't your club's team considered[n]to be quite prestigious?
entries.uk: Хіба команда вашої секції[n]не вважається доволі престижною?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: And you're their representative? I must[n]say, that's extremely impressive.
entries.uk: І ти її представниця? Мушу сказати,[n]це надзвичайно вражає.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thank you! I'll do my best to make[n]everyone proud.
entries.uk: Дякую! Я зроблю все, щоб усі[n]мною пишалися.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'll be cheering you on as well.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Ah, I have an idea—since all three of us[n]are here, why don't we go somewhere[n]as a group?
entries.uk: О, маю ідею: раз ми вже тут утрьох,[n]чому б не піти кудись разом?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We can call it our little celebration[n]for Yoshizawa-san's success.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: That would be wonderful! Does that[n]work for you, [lName]-senpai?
entries.uk: Було б чудово! Вам це підходить,[n][lName]-семпай?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That settles it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Would you mind if I chose the place?[n]There's a wonderful little café I know[n]about...
entries.uk: Не заперечуєте, якщо місце оберу я?[n]Я знаю одне чудове маленьке кафе...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Of course! Lead the way!
